thread:
alex (oncall): Heads-up: customers reporting higher latency + some responses coming from the wrong model variant after the config schema rollout this morning. Paging oncall. cc @mira @dennis @suzanne :rotating_light:

incident-bot: ALERT: routing-service.v2 - increased error rate and routing churn detected (rule: policy-eval). Pager sent to oncall.

mira (sre): On it. I'm pulling routing-service logs and policy eval traces now. Any idea which deploy changed the schema?

dennis (infra): The schema change was in config-registry at 09:12 UTC — migration to v3 removed a few aliases but kept deprecated fields for compatibility. I can see a commit: ref 8f3b2a3.

suzanne (prod-eng): We shipped a small opt-in for defaultFallbackVariant earlier to make canaries easier. Wondering if the new validator silently set defaults when deprecated fields present.

mira (sre): Confirmed: routing-service is reading a deprecated key "fallback_variant" when present and treating it as higher priority than explicit per-route variants. That explains wrong model "gpt-large-q2" routing for some traffic. Logs: `policy_eval: source=route/checkout user_id=*** variant_selected=gpt-large-q2 (from deprecated fallback_variant)`

alex (oncall): Oof. Customers seeing wrong model + p95 spike. Which regions?

mira (sre): Mostly eu-west1 and a bit in us-west1. I ran a quick query: affected request share ~2.3% over the last 15m. Latency delta +600ms median for affected requests.

dennis (infra): Looking at policy-registry, the merged schema migration included an implicit default for fallback_variant. The migration code added fallback_variant: "auto" as a default when any legacy key present. So old configs now effectively force a fallback choice.

suzanne (prod-eng): That's the surprise default behavior. We didn't expect the migration to introduce an active fallback.

mira (sre): Short mitigation plan: 1) temporarily override global policy to pin variant to stable-v1 for affected routes; 2) remove/ignore deprecated fallback_variant handling in runtime; 3) roll back migration from config-registry if needed. Which is fastest?

dennis (infra): Fastest is policy override. I can push a hotspot policy that sets route-level variant. Using redwoodctl to apply to eu-west1 first.

# command executed by dennis:
```bash
redwoodctl policy apply --scope region:eu-west1 --json '{"override": {"variant": "stable-v1"}}'
```

dennis (infra): Applied to eu-west1. Will monitor.

mira (sre): I also pushed a temporary runtime guard to ignore deprecated fallback_variant for new requests (hotpatch). Patch id runtime-guard-2028. This prevents the codepath that elevated deprecated keys.

# runtime patch (mira):
```diff
- if (cfg.fallback_variant) select(cfg.fallback_variant)
+ if (isDeprecated(cfg.fallback_variant)) ignore()
```

suzanne (prod-eng): Good. Can you confirm which customers were impacted so CS can notify?

mira (sre): Early list from logs: acme-analytics (100k reqs, mostly eu), betachat-prod (20k reqs), internal test fleet. Filing INC-9876 for tracking.

alex (oncall): Noted: open customer tickets: CS-2345 (Acme), CS-2346 (BetaChat). Please add mitigation notes.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-registry rollback -> target=8f3b2a3 -> user=dennis ETA ~5m

dennis (infra): Rollback completed to commit 8f3b2a2 (pre-migration). Registry now serves old schema behavior.

mira (sre): Traffic looks normalizing in eu-west1. Variant selection back to expected for sampled requests. Error rates falling.

suzanne (prod-eng): We'll remove the defaulting behavior from the migration script and add an explicit opt-in for fallback defaults. I'll open a PR and link it to the incident.

alex (oncall): Customer impact summary to include in postmortem: root cause = config-registry migration introduced an implicit default for deprecated field `fallback_variant` which the runtime treated as higher precedence; impact = wrong model variant selection for ~2.3% of requests (primarily eu-west1), increased latency ~600ms on affected requests, 2 paying customers impacted; mitigation = policy override, runtime guard hotpatch, rollback of migration, will revert migration script and add validator check.

mira (sre): Handoff: I'm taking on-call until 03:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-policy-misroute. If anything spikes, @alex please page me immediately.

alex (oncall): Thanks — I'm marking the incident as mitigated and handing to Mira for monitoring + postmortem. Will create a short incident timeline and assign owners.

suzanne (prod-eng): Action items: (1) PR to remove implicit default from migration (owner: suzanne), (2) add validator test to fail-on-deprecated-defaults (owner: dennis), (3) postmortem + customer comms draft (owner: alex).

mira (sre): Adding a note: add smoke check that validates model-variant parity across regions after config changes.

alex (oncall): Closing update: mitigation successful, customers notified, postmortem assigned. INC-9876 -> status: mitigated.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: on dennis' rollback message)
